items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I got a chance to go with Ray Conniff to England... I did his first recording date.

ctx.x: 'Yes, Indeed' and 'Cheating On Me,' and 'You're a Cute Little Tootie,' and all of those things. And during the same year, I got a chance to go with Ray Conniff to England.
Now, there's one thing I have to say; that Ray Coniff has been faithful, even up to this date. I was just in South America with him. But I did his first recording date.
Let the people who know who Ray Conniff was; of course, I know he was a trombone player.
